register.name: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation (ASCENT), Comoros
register.detail: World Bank · IDA grant · Approved 4 May 2026 · SONELEC
register.note: US$18.7 million for electricity and clean cooking access
register.text: An IDA grant of US$57 million to accelerate access to sustainable, reliable and clean energy on Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli, carried out through the national utility SONELEC. It strengthens and modernises the grid, supports about 42,000 new household connections with grid and off-grid solutions, and pilots scalable clean cooking solutions, where the energy standard is furthest from reach.

register.name: Accelerated Access to Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, multiphase programme
register.detail: World Bank · IDA grant · SDR 21.1M · Project Appraisal Document 24 March 2026
register.note: 200,900 people, about 40,180 households, to gain new or improved services
register.text: An IDA grant of SDR 21.1 million (US$29 million equivalent), the Comoros phase of a World Bank multiphase programme, to increase access to climate-resilient drinking water supply, sanitation and hygiene services and strengthen the governance of the sector. It serves the water standard and the sanitation measure of the shelter standard.

register.name: Extended Credit Facility, fifth review
register.text: The fifth review released SDR 3.56 million, about US$4.87 million, under the four-year arrangement approved in June 2023, bringing total disbursements under it to about US$28.62 million.
register.note: Arrangement total SDR 32.04 million, about $43 million

register.name: Nature-based climate action
register.detail: Global Environment Facility · UNEP · DGEF · Launched 11 December 2025 · five years
register.note: US$54 million in all, with US$44 million of co-financing from partners including the World Bank and AFD
register.text: A US$10 million grant from the Global Environment Facility for a five-year project executed by the General Directorate of Environment and Forests with UNEP, to conserve watersheds, enhance freshwater availability and strengthen food security and livelihoods. An accelerator is to support 300 micro, small and medium enterprises with micro-finance tools, and the project aims to help safeguard 140,000 coastal residents.

register.name: Post-Kenneth Recovery and Resilience, additional financing
register.text: Additional financing of US$12.5 million, an IDA grant, to rehabilitate 12 kilometres of climate-resilient roads and complete the Mtsangadjou to Foumbouni corridor, for 13,000 people in one of the most cyclone-affected regions of the Comoros.

register.name: National Water Resilience Project
register.text: An IDA grant of SDR 11.4 million (US$15 million equivalent) to improve access to and maintenance for basic water supply services in Grand Moroni and strengthen the governance of the sector. It targets 84,500 direct beneficiaries for new or improved services.
register.note: Basic water supply for Grand Moroni; 84,500 direct beneficiaries

register.name: Ensuring climate resilient water supplies in the Comoros Islands
register.detail: Green Climate Fund · FP094 · UNDP · Approved 20 October 2018 · estimated completion 25 June 2027
register.note: GCF grant shown as fully disbursed; US$60.8 million in all with co-financing
register.text: A Green Climate Fund grant of US$41,919,808, with UNDP as accredited entity, to secure climate-resilient water supplies in the Comoros Islands; with US$18.8 million of co-financing, the project totals US$60.8 million. It serves the water standard.

register.name: Primary health care improvement project (SUHA)
register.detail: AFD · grant · 19 March 2024 to 19 March 2027 · French Red Cross with the Ministry of Health
register.note: Adolescent girls and women first, with priority on Anjouan
register.text: A €5 million AFD grant, carried out by the French Red Cross in partnership with the Ministry of Health and Social Protection, to improve access to health services for vulnerable people, above all adolescent girls and women, with priority on Anjouan. It upgrades health facilities and the basic package of primary care, and builds the skills of staff in sexual and reproductive health.

register.name: Hospital capacity and quality of care
register.detail: AFD · grant · 18 June 2022 to 18 June 2029 · Ministry of Health · Expertise France
register.note: Five hospitals and the School of Medicine and Public Health
register.text: A €29.5 million AFD grant to the Ministry of Health and Social Protection to strengthen five hospitals (buildings, equipment, governance and the organisation of care), renovate and equip the School of Medicine and Public Health with new training programmes, and improve the steering of the national health system. It serves the health standard.

items.label: Citizens, 2025

items.name: Union des Meck
items.text: A mutualist network of savings and credit banks with 14 local branches across the three islands, and the largest microfinance provider in the Comoros, with 76% of the credit granted by the sector in 2023. Its “Coup de Pouce” product lets members borrow up to set limits without collateral.

items.name: Union des Sanduk d’Anjouan
items.text: A union of 32 affiliated savings and credit banks on Anjouan, and the second microfinance network in the Comoros after the Union des Meck, with 16% of the credit granted by the sector in 2023.

items.name: Dahari
items.text: A Comorian non-profit on Anjouan that pays farmers to conserve and restore forest on their land: under five-year agreements, farmers receive cash transfers every six months through local micro-credit associations, sized to the area conserved. Thirty farmers signed the first agreements, and about 300 more are planned in a second phase, subject to funding.
